mediaLibrary.description: Training media references for coral restoration SOPs. These entries represent stock photos, videos, and documents that organizations can use as templates or import into their training libraries.

media.title: Coral Nursery Floating Tree Structure
media.description: Overhead and underwater views of a floating coral tree nursery structure showing PVC frame construction, monofilament hanging lines, and properly spaced coral fragments. Demonstrates optimal fragment arrangement for water flow and light exposure.

media.title: Fixed Coral Nursery Table
media.description: Underwater photograph of a fixed nursery table showing concrete or rebar construction, fragment plug holders, and coral growth progression over time. Includes close-up of attachment hardware and table leg stability features.

media.title: Nursery Cleaning Demonstration Video
media.description: 5-minute instructional video showing proper technique for cleaning coral nursery structures. Demonstrates soft brush usage, algae removal around fragments, predator identification and removal, and sediment clearing without disturbing coral tissue.

media.title: Fragmentation Tool Sterilization Protocol
media.description: Step-by-step video demonstrating proper sterilization of fragmentation tools including bone cutters, saws, and handling equipment. Shows bleach solution preparation, immersion timing, rinsing, and drying procedures.

media.title: Branching Coral Fragmentation Technique
media.description: Detailed video tutorial showing proper cutting techniques for branching corals (Acropora, Pocillopora). Demonstrates bone cutter positioning, cut angle, fragment handling, and immediate post-cut care. Includes common mistakes to avoid.

media.title: Microfragmentation Process
media.description: Comprehensive video demonstrating microfragmentation technique for massive corals. Shows diamond band saw setup, fragment cutting to 1cm squares, optimal spacing on substrate, and fusion monitoring over 4-week period with time-lapse footage.

media.title: Coral Watch Color Reference Card
media.description: High-resolution image of the Coral Watch bleaching assessment color card showing D1-D6 and C1-C6 color scales. Includes instructions for proper use and interpretation of bleaching severity levels.

media.title: Healthy vs Stressed Coral Comparison
media.description: Side-by-side comparison images showing healthy coral characteristics (extended polyps, vibrant color, active growth margins) versus stressed coral indicators (retracted polyps, pale tissue, algae overgrowth). Multiple species represented.

media.title: White Syndrome Disease Examples
media.description: Photo compilation showing various white syndrome presentations including white band disease, white plague, and white pox. Each image labeled with disease type, affected species, and characteristic progression patterns.

media.title: SCTLD Identification Guide
media.description: Detailed photo guide for Stony Coral Tissue Loss Disease identification. Shows characteristic lesion patterns, affected species, progression rates, and differentiating features from other white syndromes. Includes early vs advanced stage comparisons.

media.title: Outplant Site Assessment Criteria
media.description: Visual guide showing optimal and suboptimal outplanting site characteristics. Includes substrate types, sediment levels, current indicators, and habitat quality examples. Annotated photographs explain selection criteria.

media.title: Underwater Cement Mixing and Application
media.description: Tutorial video demonstrating underwater cement preparation and application for coral attachment. Shows proper mixing ratios, consistency testing, application technique, and fragment positioning with elevation above substrate.

media.title: Proper Fragment Elevation Technique
media.description: Close-up images showing correct fragment elevation above substrate (2-3cm clearance) versus common errors (tissue contact with substrate, insufficient elevation). Demonstrates importance of elevation for sediment avoidance and water circulation.

media.title: Quarantine System Setup
media.description: Photo series showing proper quarantine system configuration including isolated tank setup, separate filtration, dedicated equipment storage, and biosecurity labeling. Includes flow diagram for water handling.

media.title: Antibiotic Paste Application for SCTLD
media.description: Step-by-step video demonstrating Base 2B amoxicillin paste preparation and underwater application to SCTLD lesions. Shows proper coverage technique, tools used, and expected treatment results over 7-day monitoring period.

media.title: Black Band Disease Aspiration Treatment
media.description: Video tutorial showing black band disease treatment using aspiration technique. Demonstrates syringe aspiration of cyanobacterial mat, clay/epoxy coverage application, and monitoring for band reformation.

media.title: Water Quality Parameter Reference Chart
media.description: Comprehensive reference chart showing optimal ranges for all key water quality parameters (temperature, salinity, pH, alkalinity, calcium, magnesium, nutrients) with color-coded acceptable vs concerning vs critical ranges.

media.title: pH Meter Calibration Procedure
media.description: Instructional video showing proper pH meter calibration using standard buffer solutions. Includes probe cleaning, two-point calibration technique, slope verification, and storage procedures.

media.title: Water Change Procedure Video
media.description: Complete water change tutorial showing saltwater mixing, parameter matching, slow addition technique, and post-change verification. Emphasizes importance of temperature and salinity matching before introduction.

media.title: BWRAF Buddy Check Demonstration
media.description: Video demonstrating complete pre-dive buddy check procedure using BWRAF system (BCD, Weights, Releases, Air, Final check). Two divers show proper inspection points and verbal confirmation process.

media.title: Standard Dive Hand Signals Reference
media.description: Visual reference guide showing standard recreational and scientific diving hand signals. Includes OK, problems, directional signals, air status, and emergency signals with clear underwater photography examples.

media.title: Diver Rescue Techniques
media.description: Comprehensive rescue technique video covering distressed diver approach, establishing positive buoyancy, controlled ascent with unconscious diver, surface rescue, and emergency oxygen administration.

media.title: Coral Species Identification Guide - Caribbean
media.description: Comprehensive photo guide covering major Caribbean coral species used in restoration. Includes Acropora cervicornis, A. palmata, Orbicella species complex, Diploria labyrinthiformis, Porites astreoides, and others. Features identification tips and species-specific care notes.

media.title: Coral Species Identification Guide - Indo-Pacific
media.description: Comprehensive photo guide covering major Indo-Pacific coral species used in restoration. Includes Acropora species, Pocillopora, Porites, Montipora, Stylophora, and others. Features growth forms, identification tips, and regional variations.

media.title: Coral Growth Measurement Techniques
media.description: Tutorial video demonstrating various coral growth measurement methods including linear extension, photogrammetry, 3D modeling, and weight-based calculations. Compares accuracy and practical application of each method.

media.title: Fragment Mounting on Plugs
media.description: Detailed video showing proper technique for mounting coral fragments on ceramic plugs and concrete discs. Demonstrates epoxy vs gel adhesive application, proper positioning, and elevation above plug surface.

media.title: Donor Colony Selection Criteria
media.description: Visual guide showing characteristics of ideal donor colonies for fragmentation. Demonstrates assessment of health indicators, growth margins, size requirements, and genetic diversity considerations.

media.title: Substrate Preparation for Outplanting
media.description: Video demonstration of substrate cleaning and preparation procedures including wire brushing, algae removal, and optimal attachment point selection on natural reef substrate.

media.title: Proper Coral Tagging Methods
media.description: Photo guide showing waterproof tag types, attachment methods, and positioning guidelines for coral identification tagging. Includes numbering systems and database integration best practices.

media.title: Marine Life Hazards for Divers
media.description: Identification guide for potentially hazardous marine life encountered during restoration diving. Includes sharks, jellyfish, fire coral, sea urchins, stingrays with avoidance strategies and first aid for encounters.

media.title: Controlled Ascent Demonstration
media.description: Video showing proper controlled ascent technique including ascent rate monitoring, safety stop procedure, buddy positioning during ascent, and surface marker buoy deployment.

media.title: Equipment Failure Drill Scenarios
media.description: Training video demonstrating responses to common equipment failures: free-flowing regulator, BCD malfunction, mask loss, weight system failure. Includes controlled practice scenarios.

media.title: Disease Identification Flowchart
media.description: Decision-tree flowchart for coral disease identification based on visual symptoms. Guides observer through lesion characteristics, progression patterns, and affected species to determine likely disease type.

media.title: Black Band Disease Characteristics
media.description: Detailed photographs of black band disease showing cyanobacterial mat appearance, progression direction, affected species, and seasonal occurrence patterns.

media.title: Photo Documentation Setup
media.description: Visual guide showing proper setup for coral photography including camera positioning, color reference card placement, scale bar usage, and lighting considerations for consistent documentation.

media.title: Massive Coral Cutting with Band Saw
media.description: Tutorial video demonstrating proper technique for cutting massive coral species using a diamond band saw. Shows water flow management, cutting depth control, and fragment handling.

media.title: Initial Site Assessment Procedure
media.description: Video showing systematic site assessment methodology from surface observation through underwater survey. Demonstrates checklist usage, hazard identification, and go/no-go decision making.

media.title: Temperature Control Systems Overview
media.description: Photo documentation of various temperature control systems used in coral aquaculture including chillers, heaters, heat exchangers, and monitoring equipment with installation best practices.

media.title: Visual Health Indicators Reference
media.description: Comprehensive photo reference showing full spectrum of coral health indicators from excellent to critical condition. Includes polyp extension patterns, tissue coloration, growth characteristics, and stress responses.

media.title: Coral Restoration Field Guide
media.description: Comprehensive PDF field guide combining species identification, health assessment protocols, disease identification, and emergency procedures into a waterproof-printable format for field use.
